messages:
Dana (CSM): Quick sync — HelioPay wants a focused 90-min hands-on POC->Prod lab to unblock their platform engineers and reduce renewal risk. Proposed slots: Tue 2024-05-14 or Thu 2024-05-16. Who can lead and who can co-run? @Priya @Jules

Priya (Solutions Eng): I can lead Thu 16, prefer 11:00–12:30 PT. Can demo Dedicated + VPC networking flow and walk through a small infra checklist. Will need a short runbook.

Jules (Enablement): I can co-run and own post-session feedback capture. Draft agenda below.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Drop agenda if you want me to tweak it.

Jules (Enablement): ```
- 0–10m: Objectives + success criteria
- 10–35m: Infra overview (VPC peering, routing, secrets)
- 35–80m: Guided migration lab (customer provides sample data)
- 80–90m: Next steps, rollouts, and Q/A
```

Marco (Customer Success): FYI account health shows medium risk — they have an external demo next week. This lab is high priority for conversion. Also asking them for infra artifacts and list of participants.

Sarah (HelioPay): Thu 16 at 11 PT works for our side. We'll send a short list of attendees (3 engineers + PM) and share a tiny sample dataset.

Dana (CSM): Great. @ops-bot can you create Zoom + calendar event and add RSVP? Need recording enabled and attach pre-read and feedback link. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Meeting created — https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 — calendar invite sent to guests. Recording enabled.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a 10-min sandbox script and a deploy checklist. @Jules can you make a 3-question feedback form to track readiness? :memo:

Jules (Enablement): Yep. I'll add a post-session form and a quick boolean metric: "staging run successful". Will attach to calendar and set an automated reminder 24h after.

Dana (CSM): Action items: Priya = lab lead + artifacts, Jules = feedback + materials + automation, Marco = confirm attendees + account notes, Dana = update renewal-risk tracker and run internal prep call. Internal prep: Tue 2024-05-14 09:00 PT (15 mins) for leads.

Sarah (HelioPay): One ask — please include role expectations in the invite (PM, infra eng, optional security).

Priya (Solutions Eng): Will add role guidance to calendar notes and include a short pre-read with commands to run.

Dana (CSM): Closing — primary success signal: customer can run their workload in staging during the guided lab. Secondary: agreement to next-step Dedicated trial. Thanks everyone :rocket:
